visual.general_description: Scatter plot of body mass index percentile against age in years with one dashed and four dotted vertical marker lines.
visual.detailed_description: Black-and-white graph on a white background. The x axis is labelled Age (years) with tick labels 9, 10, 11, 12 and 13; the y axis is labelled Percentile with tick labels 0, 20, 40, 60 and 80. Filled black circles, one per plotted visit, are scattered across the plot with no connecting line. A bold dashed vertical line near the 11-year tick is labelled CFRD at the top. Four fine dotted vertical lines to its right are labelled T1, T2, T3 and T4 from left to right at the top. Points to the left of the CFRD line sit in a generally higher band, then drop below it after the CFRD line; around the T1 and T2 lines the points are at their lowest, and points rise again toward and after T3 and T4, with the last points at the highest level of the post-CFRD period. No legend, panel letters, patient identifiers or text other than axis labels and marker labels are visible.
